reader_summary.headline: Today, we're replaying my conversation with Danny Meyer.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we're replaying my conversation with Danny Meyer. He is the founder and CEO of Union Square Hospitality Group, which comprises some of the most acclaimed restaurants in New York. Danny is also the founder and chairman of Shake Shack, which began in NYC but is now a publicly traded company with hundreds of locations worldwide.

key_points.text: He is the founder and CEO of Union Square Hospitality Group, which comprises some of the most acclaimed restaurants in New York.
Our conversation focuses on how great hospitality leads to a great business, regardless of what sector it's in.
We discuss why hospitality is the starting point for Danny’s business philosophy, why first impressions matter, Danny’s concept of ABCD - always be connecting dots.
